summary.content:
Today's selection covers 43 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 28 on Artificial Intelligence and 9 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Hackers Use AI for Exploit Development, Attack Automation
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Skoda Data Breach Hits Online Shop Customers
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from Dark Reading, SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 17 articles published in the last 24 hours

top.description: Cyber adversaries have long used AI, but now attackers are using large language models to develop exploits and orchestrate complex attacks.
